# Zenra AI

> Zenra AI is an AI and software development company working with clients worldwide. It designs, builds and launches AI agents, custom AI tools, websites and web apps, online stores, and Windows, Mac and mobile apps. It also makes its own products. Zenra AI Agent is an AI chat agent for any website, and Zenra Video Downloader, Zenra AI Viral Clips and Zenra Video Splitter are Windows apps for creators.

Key facts:
- Name: Zenra AI, website https://zenraai.com
- Type: AI and software development company working with clients worldwide, in English.
- Services: AI agent development, custom AI development (custom AI tools, chatbots and AI features built on the client's data), custom web development (websites, web apps and landing pages), e-commerce development (Shopify, WooCommerce and custom stores, plus monthly store management) and desktop and mobile app development (Windows, Mac, iPhone and Android apps).
- Delivery: Most projects are delivered within a few days. Bigger projects usually take about 5 to 6 days, sometimes a little more or less. The exact timeline is agreed with each client before work starts.
- Pricing: every project starts with a free estimate based on the client's idea and budget, followed by a fixed quote in US dollars, paid by milestone. Monthly plans cover ongoing work such as store management, agent care and support. Project form: https://zenraai.com/contact/
- Process: a free 30-minute discovery call, a written proposal with a fixed quote, design or prototype, the build with live previews and progress updates, launch, then optional support.
- Ownership: clients own the code, designs, domains and accounts from day one. NDA on request.
- AI agents are built with approvals for important actions, human handoff, audit logs and least-privilege access.
- Ready-made agent: Zenra AI Agent answers customers around the clock on any website (WordPress, Shopify, Wix and more) or on a shareable chat link and QR code. It replies in the customer's language, saves leads, hands chats to the team, learns from the business's website and files and runs on free Cloudflare hosting. Page: https://zenraai.com/agents/zenra-ai-agent/
- Own apps for Windows 10 and 11, with Mac versions coming soon. Zenra Video Downloader saves videos, playlists and channels from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X and more in up to 4K or MP3, with a 1-day free trial, then $1 a month, $2 for 6 months, $3 a year or $10 lifetime. Zenra AI Viral Clips turns long videos into ready-to-post clips in 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9 with captions, titles, speaker framing and ball following for sports, with a 30-day free trial, then $4 a month, $10 for 6 months, $15 a year or $35 lifetime. Zenra Video Splitter splits any video into equal clips in original quality for free.
- Replies to project inquiries within one business day.
- Contact: support@zenraai.com or https://zenraai.com/contact/

## Services
- [All services](https://zenraai.com/services/): AI agent development, custom AI development, custom web development, e-commerce development and desktop and mobile apps, all from one team, worldwide.
- [AI agent development](https://zenraai.com/services/ai-agent-development/): Custom AI agents for customer support, sales and operations that connect to your apps, with approvals, logs and human handoff. Free estimate and fixed quote.
- [Custom AI development](https://zenraai.com/services/ai-tool-development/): Custom AI development for business. AI tools, chatbots and assistants built on your own data, from document extraction to knowledge search and AI features.
- [Custom web development](https://zenraai.com/services/custom-web-development/): Custom websites, web apps and landing pages that are fast, secure, SEO ready and easy to update, built with modern frameworks for a fixed quote, in days.
- [E-commerce development](https://zenraai.com/services/ecommerce-development/): Shopify, WooCommerce and custom e-commerce websites built to sell, with payments, shipping, migrations, speed work and monthly store management included.
- [Desktop and mobile app development](https://zenraai.com/services/app-development/): Desktop and mobile app development for Windows, Mac, iPhone and Android, with installers, automatic updates, licensing, payments and app store launch.

## AI agents
- [Ready-made AI agents](https://zenraai.com/agents/): Ready-made AI agents from Zenra AI. Zenra AI Agent answers customers day and night on your website or a chat link, saves leads and hands chats to your team.
- [Zenra AI Agent](https://zenraai.com/agents/zenra-ai-agent/): An AI chatbot for your website that answers customers 24/7 in their language, saves every lead and hands chats to your team. Trained on your own business.

## Creator apps
- [Apps for creators](https://zenraai.com/tools/): Zenra creator apps for Windows, with Mac coming soon. Video Downloader for 4K playlists and channels, AI Viral Clips for short videos and a free Video Splitter.
- [Zenra Video Downloader](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-video-downloader/): Video downloader for Windows PC. Save YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and X videos, playlists and whole channels in up to 4K or as MP3. Free trial.
- [Zenra AI Viral Clips](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-ai-viral-clips/): AI clip maker for Windows that turns long videos into Shorts, Reels and TikToks in 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9 with captions, titles and auto framing. Free trial.
- [Zenra Video Splitter](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-video-splitter/): Free Windows app that splits any video into equal parts in seconds, in original quality, with cuts at natural pauses for WhatsApp Status, Shorts and Reels.

## Blog
- [AI agent vs chatbot and which one your business needs](https://zenraai.com/blog/ai-agent-vs-chatbot/): A chatbot answers questions. An AI agent also takes actions in your apps. Learn how they differ, what each costs to run and how to choose for your business.
- [Desktop app vs web app and which one your business should build](https://zenraai.com/blog/desktop-app-vs-web-app/): Desktop app or web app? Compare speed, offline use, updates, cost and reach, see real examples and find out which one fits your users and your budget best.
- [E-commerce website vs Facebook page for selling online](https://zenraai.com/blog/ecommerce-website-vs-facebook-page/): Selling on a Facebook page is a great start. See how it compares with your own online store, what you gain from each and the signs it is time to build one.
- [How to download videos on a PC in HD and 4K (2026 guide)](https://zenraai.com/blog/how-to-download-videos-on-pc/): A step-by-step guide to saving YouTube and other videos, playlists and audio on a Windows PC in HD or 4K, and how to do it responsibly and within the rules.
- [Shopify vs WooCommerce and which is better for your online store](https://zenraai.com/blog/shopify-vs-woocommerce/): Shopify or WooCommerce? A plain comparison of costs, ease of use, control, payments and growth, plus a simple way to decide which fits your online store.
- [How to split a long video for WhatsApp Status on a PC (free)](https://zenraai.com/blog/split-video-for-whatsapp-status/): Split a long video into equal parts for WhatsApp Status, Shorts or Reels on a Windows PC for free, in original quality, with no watermark and no upload.
- [How to turn one long video into 30 short clips](https://zenraai.com/blog/turn-long-videos-into-short-clips/): A practical workflow for turning podcasts, interviews and vlogs into Shorts, Reels and TikToks, what makes a clip work and how to do it in hours, not days.
- [What is AI tool development? 5 ways custom AI tools help small businesses](https://zenraai.com/blog/what-is-ai-tool-development/): What custom AI tools are, where they save real time and money, five ways they help a business and how to start a first project without wasting budget.
